theme.title: Theme
theme.note: System follows the light or dark setting of the operating system.

language.title: Language
language.note: System follows the language of the operating system.

title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences of this app on this computer. Changes apply right away.

keyType.title: Default key type
keyType.note: Preselected when you generate a key. Ed25519 is recommended.

fontSize.title: Terminal font size
fontSize.note: From {min} to {max} px. Open terminals update immediately.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.doNotTrack: Off because DO_NOT_TRACK is set on this computer. Nothing is sent.
privacy.readError: Could not read this setting. Restart the app.
privacy.unavailable: This build does not send usage data. Changes are still saved.

data.title: Data
data.note: Export projects, hosts, collections and variables to a file, or import one. Passwords and other secrets are never included. App settings are not included.

externalEditor.title: External editor
externalEditor.customNote: Files open with this app; the file is its only argument.
externalEditor.systemNote: Files open with the app your system uses for their type. Scripts and programs are never run: pick a custom app to edit them.
externalEditor.pickHint: Pick the editor's program file. Until then, files open with the system default app.
externalEditor.copyNote: While you edit, a copy of the file is stored on this computer and deleted when you stop editing.
externalEditor.notice: Show a notice before opening a file outside Carapace
externalEditor.notAnEditor: This program runs scripts or commands; it is not an editor. Pick your editor's program file.
